title: fix(app-shell): a decided approval step shows its step and decision in "Approval progress" instead of an empty card
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D62xGLMbyWJaMEVnAMEjTK1)_
Fixes #35730
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：审批单页面右侧「审批进度」卡，第一步就已审批（或只有一步的流程）的审批单，现在显示这一步和它的结果（已通过 ✓、已拒绝 ✗、已退回、已撤回、已取消），不再是一张空卡；什么都没得显示时整张卡不画。
- 为什么做：审批流程（工作流）里的审批中心体验，修维护者报的 p1：审批过的第一步审批单，「审批进度」是空的。
- 出错会怎样：只影响审批单页面这张进度卡的显示，不改数据、不改接口；有问题直接撤回这个改动即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

On an approval request's page, the "Approval progress" rail card has three parts: the step line, the tally, and who it waits on. A request decided at its flow's first step, or in a one-step flow, drew none of them: the step line drew only from two steps up, a single-approver step serves no `decision_progress`, and a decided request waits on nobody. So the card was an empty shell.

- `ApprovalStepLine` takes an optional `decided` (the request's status, passed only when `flow_route.ahead === 'decided'`). For a decided route it draws from one step, and the route's last step (the request's own, per `flowRoute`, which returns passed steps then the own step for a non-pending row) is drawn with its decision: a marker (check / cross / undo / minus) and the status word from the `approvalsInbox.status*` rows. The served step state is `current` for every non-approved decision, so a rejected, returned, recalled or cancelled own step is no longer drawn as the amber "in progress" step. A pending route still needs two steps, unchanged (pinned).
- The step-count gate is exported once as `stepLineDraws`, and the panel's waiting-on gate as `waitsOnAnyone`; the panel draws the progress card only when one of its three parts draws. A card with nothing in it is not drawn (the card's option (b) as the fallback guard).
- New locale row `approvalsInbox.statusCancelled` in all 11 ui language packs (no status label existed for `cancelled`).

Not done here, on purpose: a line saying whether the record's approval went on to a later step or ended. The page does not hold that: a decided row's `flow_route` walks nothing past the own step (`ahead: 'decided'`), and the request row names no later request of its run. Drawing it would be a guess. Follow-up: the server-side `flow_route` would have to carry it, which is a contract change outside this card.

## Evals

<details><summary>New pins (in the existing harness file, as a new top-level describe)</summary>

`ApprovalDecisionPanel.stepLine-12491.test.tsx`, describe "a decided request draws its own step and its decision":

- a single-step request decided approved / rejected / returned / recalled / cancelled draws its one step, carrying `data-decision`, the status word, no amber marker and no step number;
- a request rejected at its second step draws the passed step undecorated and its own step rejected, label not bold;
- the decision word carries no `shrink-0` / `whitespace-nowrap` and does carry `break-words` (the phone-width pattern: happy-dom applies no Tailwind, so the class tokens are read);
- a pending request with one step still draws no line (unchanged behaviour);
- a progress card with nothing to show is not drawn (pending with one step and nobody waiting; decided with no route).

Red first, re-run on the final base (e1143241de): with `origin/main`'s `ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` and `ApprovalStepLine.tsx` checked out, 8 of the 9 new tests failed (`Tests  8 failed | 5 passed (13)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 1; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty, both blobs equal HEAD) (`Unable to find a label with the text of: Approval steps`, with the card itself found, which is the empty shell); the pending pin passed, as it should.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation of the decided branch</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the panel's `decided: request.flow_route?.ahead === 'decided' ? request.status : undefined,` with `decided: undefined,` (anchor hit x1, marker count 0 then 1 on disk; run by the first session on the pre-merge head 77576d09, the ablated lines unchanged since). The file ran 7 failed / 6 passed: every decided pin red, the pending and no-card pins and the four existing pins green. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty (the tool's own check).

</details>

Two-minute check: open a request decided at the first step of its flow (or any request of a one-step flow) on the approval request page. The "Approval progress" card shows one step with its decision word; a rejected one has a red cross, not an amber number.

## Acceptance notes

- Changeset written to the root `.changeset/`, not `ui/.changeset/` as the dispatch order named: ui/AGENTS.md says the root config does not read `ui/.changeset/` and nothing new goes there.
- The decided own step's decision is read from the request's `status`, which the page already binds; `flow_route` step states have no decided vocabulary of their own (`done` / `current` / `upcoming`). Giving a decided step its own served state would be a spec change; not proposed here.
- The "went on / ended" line above is the named follow-up.
- One existing console test waited for the "Approval progress" card as its sign that the page had loaded: the served-page control for a request with no submitted record (`approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageSummary-12483.test.tsx`). Measured with a throwaway probe: its row has no route, no tally and nobody waiting, so on `main` the card held only its title (`card="Approval progress"`, 0 step lines, 0 bars, 0 chips) and on this branch it is not drawn (rail = activity only). That is the empty shell this PR removes, not a regression, so the control now waits for the Reject action instead; every assertion it made is kept. No other test under `ui/` waits on the card for a row with nothing to draw.
- The business record's own approvals panel also draws `ApprovalStepLine` and passes no `decided`, so it is unchanged here; whether it should mark a decided step the same way is left to its own card.

Files to read first: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-progress/ApprovalStepLine.tsx` (the decided branch and the gate), then `ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` (the card gate).
